baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal construction links the declaration at word 1 to completed endurance at word 4, then evaluates the consequence and dwelling at words 6-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-restraint holds against panic until harm has passed; the opening declares intactness and peace, the evaluative verb approves it, and the final nouns locate that approved consequence in settled residence.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from injury supplies the declared intactness produced by the mechanism.
Restraint of the self against panic supplies the operative endurance.
The branch of explicit commendation turns the consequence into an approved verdict.
The last consequence supplies the temporal result of the restraint.
Residence and attachment to a house supply the settled locus of that result.

changed_reading.before: A courteous greeting followed by praise of a heavenly home.
changed_reading.after: A verdict of secured wholeness: restraint has carried the addressees through danger into an approved and settled consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1 and 4 can be read socially, while words 6-7 describe what succeeds and circulates after the strain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Endurance is sustained surety and staying-with; its product is reconciliation rather than merely private calm. The praised dwelling is therefore a continuity of relations that survives changing conditions.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation opposed to conflict supplies the social state announced at the end.
Surety and remaining alongside others make endurance a relational obligation.
A benefit conveyed to another makes the praised result shared rather than solitary.
Succession supplies the continuity that follows the endured strain.
The circulation of conditions and affairs makes the dwelling an enduring social order.

changed_reading.before: Individual emotional endurance earns an individual reward.
changed_reading.after: Staying answerable to others carries a conflict-prone household into a peaceable continuity that outlasts the ordeal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The consequence at word 6 and dwelling at word 7 both retain motions of return, repetition, and circling.
baseline_models.mechanism: Endurance holds the trajectory until it bends back safely; the excellent consequence can be a fitting homecoming rather than only a terminal reward, with dwelling understood as the stable center of a completed circuit.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint keeps the returning trajectory from breaking under distress.
A place that fits and permits good staying supplies the quality of the homecoming.
Turning back on the heel makes return a live motion inside the consequence noun.
Circling and enclosure supply the completed circuit that becomes dwelling.
Intact arrival distinguishes safe return from mere reversal or retreat.

changed_reading.before: The verse points linearly from patience to a final destination.
changed_reading.after: It can also stage a safe return into a fitting center, so the praised ending has the geometry of homecoming.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence couples haste with putting harm before good and then closes on the punitive branch of the same root later used for the praised consequence. Endurance is thus not empty delay: it refuses a premature ordering that would make what follows punitive.

activation_trace.role: Speed and premature advancement supply the temporal pressure opposed by endurance.
Precedence makes the bad-before-good ordering structurally explicit.
Punishment after fault supplies the adverse polarity available to the consequence root.
Restrained persistence blocks the impulse to force the sequence early.
The eventual consequence supplies the delayed alternative to premature punishment.
Commendation explicitly selects the favorable polarity of that consequence.

structural_cues: 13:6 orders harm before good under haste and ends with punishment; 13:24 inserts completed endurance before commending the consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speed, precedence, and the punitive and favorable branches of one consequence root; I infer that restraint changes the sequence's polarity. A live alternative is that the ayat simply contrast two groups without making timing causal.

changed_reading.before: Patience merely waits long enough to receive a positive result.
changed_reading.after: Patience preserves the right order of arrival: refusing premature harm-before-good allows the same consequence-root to close as commendation rather than punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the consequence root into successive agents before and behind who guard, while change must also occur within. Safety is therefore dynamically maintained by relay and responsive self-change, not merely bestowed after all danger is over.

activation_trace.role: One thing succeeding another supplies the relay structure of the protective agents.
Alternation of one after another reinforces protection by succession.
Guarding and watch supply the relay's protective function.
Changing one state into another makes inner response part of the maintained trajectory.
Intactness from harm is the state that succession preserves.
Self-restraint supplies the human side of responsive preservation.

structural_cues: 13:11 surrounds the person from front and rear, then shifts from external guarding to what is within persons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive guardianship and an inner-change condition; I infer a maintained circuit of safety in which endurance participates. The alternative is that the guarding scene and the focus greeting remain independent assurances.

changed_reading.before: The opening announces safety only after endurance has finished.
changed_reading.after: It can announce integrity maintained through a succession of protection and inner recalibration, with endurance functioning throughout the dangerous interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier appeal extends hands toward water yet neither receives an answer nor reaches its goal. Immediately before the focus, entry succeeds through every gate; the opening declaration can therefore act as a delivered admission and recognition, not only describe an already possessed peace.

activation_trace.role: Answering speech supplies the response that the failed appeal lacks.
The literally extended hand supplies an attempted transfer across a gap.
The palm localizes the failed receiving surface.
Arrival at a goal marks precisely what the water fails to do.
Successful entry supplies the achieved crossing that reverses the failed reach.
An entrance makes each gate a concrete delivery threshold.
Handing over and releasing a thing make the declaration itself a successful transfer.

structural_cues: 13:14 negates reaching despite an outstretched receiving gesture; 13:23 repeats entry and universalizes the gates; 13:24 directs the declaration onto the recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed reach, successful entry, multiple thresholds, and a transfer branch in the focus; I infer that the utterance performs admission. The live alternative is an ordinary greeting spoken only after admission is complete.

changed_reading.before: The declaration reports the peaceful condition of people already inside.
changed_reading.after: It is also the successfully delivered threshold act that recognizes and admits them at every opening, in pointed contrast to speech and water that never arrive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured flow and smelting both raise transient foam, which is expelled, while what benefits remains. Endurance becomes selective retention under turbulence, and the consequence becomes the useful residue that survives rather than simply a prize appended later.

activation_trace.role: A bounded measure gives each channel a capacity rather than undifferentiated accumulation.
Floating froth supplies the agitated but non-enduring layer.
What is cast away supplies active expulsion from the retained result.
Benefit opposed to harm identifies the value criterion of the filter.
Remaining steadily while waiting supplies the persistence of useful matter.
Holding the self supplies the focus-anchored capacity that performs retention.
A remainder and its trace make the praised consequence what is left after separation.

structural_cues: 13:17 runs parallel water and fire processes, then uses paired clauses to contrast what leaves with what remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured channels, expendable froth, casting away, and beneficial persistence; I infer that endurance functions as the filter and that outcome is residue. The alternative is that the material analogy concerns truth and falsehood only, without specifying endurance.

changed_reading.before: Patience is undifferentiated waiting for a later reward.
changed_reading.after: Patience is a selective holding capacity: agitation is released, benefit remains, and the praised outcome is the durable residue of the process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in defines a load-bearing network through completion, repeated care, binding, and connection; the inverse passage undoes, severs, and corrupts that network before naming a bad dwelling. Endurance is the tensile persistence that keeps relations connected, and peace is the sound topology that results.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficit supplies full performance of an obligation.
Preserving something state after state makes covenant maintenance durative.
Undoing a bound construction supplies the exact failure that endurance prevents.
A confirmed compact supplies the network's binding force.
Sustaining connection and refusing estrangement supplies ongoing relational work.
Severing a connection supplies the topological inverse of that work.
Departure from sound order names the systemic result of severance.
An enclosing adverse turn makes the bad dwelling a corrupted regime, not just a building.
Surety and staying alongside others supply the tensile persistence of the network.
Reconciliation opposed to conflict names the network's restored state.

structural_cues: 13:20-22 accumulates keeping, joining, worship, spending, and the branchless repel-with-good cue at 13:22 word 13 before naming endurance; 13:25 mirrors it with undoing, cutting, corruption, and a bad dwelling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a preserve-and-connect sequence and its sever-and-corrupt inverse; I infer that endurance is the force maintaining this relational topology. The alternative is a list of separate virtues whose order does not imply one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Endurance is an inward virtue rewarded in a private afterlife.
changed_reading.after: Endurance is covenantal maintenance under load: it keeps commanded relations joined until reconciliation becomes the dwelling's shared condition, while severance produces the opposite dwelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Successive context verses repeatedly turn toward return, a good place of return, and return to the Lord. These recurrences activate the focus roots of turning-back and circling, strengthening the baseline in which the consequence is homecoming rather than a merely linear terminus.

activation_trace.role: Habitual return supplies repeated reorientation toward a destination.
Goodness opposed to ugliness qualifies the return as desirable.
Returning to a place supplies explicit homeward motion.
Turning back on the heel lets consequence include return rather than only finality.
Circling supplies the recurrent geometry within which home becomes the center.
A fitting place and pleasant stay make the returned-to center inhabitable.

structural_cues: 13:27, 13:29, and 13:30 place three different return formations in close succession, with the middle verse explicitly evaluating the return as good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated return vocabulary plus focus branches of reversal and circling; I infer a homecoming loop. A live alternative keeps every return expression pointed to one final eschatological endpoint rather than recurrent reorientation.

changed_reading.before: The praised consequence is a one-way terminal destination.
changed_reading.after: It is also a completed homecoming: repeated reorientation finally settles into the fitting center to which the path has been bending.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image joins flowing channels, recurring yield, enduring cover, and paired consequences. The dwelling becomes a regenerative regime whose circulation continues to produce nourishment and shelter; the praised outcome is ongoing viability rather than inert possession of a structure.

activation_trace.role: Continuous flow supplies the regime's circulation.
A river cutting a course through earth supplies durable channels for that flow.
Yield from tree and crop supplies recurring nourishment rather than one-time reward.
Still endurance and continuity stabilize the recurring yield.
Sheltering shade supplies persistent environmental protection.
Two succeeding outcomes expose consequence as a regime that can reproduce opposite futures.
Circulation and enclosure anchor the ecological regime back in the focus dwelling.

structural_cues: 13:35 coordinates flow, yield, and shade, then repeats the consequence noun for opposed groups rather than treating outcome as a single neutral endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuing flow, produce, cover, and paired consequences; I infer that dwelling names a self-renewing regime. The alternative is that these are independent ornaments of a fixed destination.

changed_reading.before: The dwelling is a fixed house granted after endurance.
changed_reading.after: The dwelling is a durable ecology: flow, nourishment, and shelter keep circulating, so the excellent consequence is a life-supporting regime that continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed term has a binding record; traces can be erased or confirmed; judgment then admits no reviewer and accounting is rapid. The focus declaration can therefore be heard as clearance after review, with endurance naming what remained sound through revision and the praised consequence becoming final non-reopenable status.

activation_trace.role: A fixed temporal limit supplies the point at which review closes.
A written fixing that obliges judgment supplies the binding record.
Erasure of a trace supplies revision and removal from the record.
Persistence and confirmation supply what survives revision.
Adjudication between parties supplies the legal decision.
Review, objection, and attempted reversal supply precisely what the decision excludes.
Counting and accounting supply the audit that reaches closure.
Freedom from defect or injury supplies the content of final clearance.
Commendation functions as approval of the cleared outcome.

structural_cues: 13:38 pairs each term with a record, 13:39 opposes erasure and confirmation, and 13:41 negates further review before naming rapid accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a record, revision, confirmation, adjudication, and excluded review; I infer an audit-to-clearance sequence. The alternative is that these clauses concern divine decree generally and do not recast the focus utterance as a verdict.

changed_reading.before: The declaration is a greeting when reward simply arrives.
changed_reading.after: It can be a final clearance on a reviewed record: endurance is what remained sound through possible erasure, the result is approved, and no objection reopens it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it literalizes rare spatial branches into one route; it remains anchored in four focus roots that independently supply means, hard ground, steep pass, and circuit. Render only as an exploratory spatial analogy, not as the lexical replacement for the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 1, 4, 6, and 7 can form a route from means of ascent through hard terrain and a steep pass into a completed circuit.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or enabling means supplies access to the ascent.
Coarse stone and pebbly ground supply the difficult surface traversed.
A difficult rising pass supplies the route's decisive obstacle.
A completed circuit and enclosure turn arrival into inhabitable completion.
Commendation makes the arrival an acclamation rather than mere exhaustion.

changed_reading.before: A stationary greeting is spoken in a finished dwelling.
changed_reading.after: The utterance can be imagined as an acclamation at the far side of a stony ascent, where completing the hard circuit is itself arrival home.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because sale, surety, and warranty branches import an economic-legal domain; it stays valid as an analogy because every component is focus-rooted and yields a coherent changed reading. Downstream prose should call it a settlement metaphor, never a claim that the surface expression denotes a transaction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The five focus roots can align as advance, surety, benefit, settlement guarantee, and circulating affairs.

activation_trace.role: An advance-payment transaction supplies value committed before delivery.
Surety and guarantee make endurance the pledged security that remains liable.
A conveyed benefit supplies what is finally received.
Substitution and warranty supply settlement of the prior obligation.
Circulating affairs supply the interval across which the obligation matures.

changed_reading.before: Endurance earns an unrelated wage afterward.
changed_reading.after: Endurance resembles value advanced under surety, while the praised dwelling is the eventual settlement and receipt of a benefit already committed to through fidelity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because bitter sap, tanning material, softness, and drying are material branches far from ordinary syntax; it remains focus-anchored and exposes a coherent transformation from raw vulnerability to soundness. Render as a curing analogy with explicit uncertainty, not as philological derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots alone permit a material sequence of bitter treatment, drying, softening, and restored soundness.

activation_trace.role: A bitter plant extract supplies the astringent treatment rather than passive waiting.
A tree used in tanning supplies a process that makes vulnerable material durable.
Drying and hardening vegetation supply the transformation's terminal phase.
Softness and ease supply the paradoxical quality produced after harsh treatment.
Repeated circulation supplies the duration of the curing process.

changed_reading.before: Patience is simply enduring pain until it stops.
changed_reading.after: The ordeal can be imagined as bitter curing: repeated treatment and drying transform vulnerability into a supple, durable soundness announced at the end.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a rare cloud branch of the focus endurance root is activated by literal weather and angelic scenes; it remains anchored through that exact focus branch and the final safety branch. Render as an atmospheric analogy for accumulated pressure and safe discharge, not as identification of endurance with weather.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The endurance root at word 4 includes accumulated cloud imagery, while word 1 can mark intactness after a dangerous atmospheric sequence.

activation_trace.role: A flash supplies visible charge and the fear-hope threshold.
A drawn cloud mass supplies literal atmospheric accumulation.
Heaviness supplies the pressure borne by the accumulating mass.
A descending thunderbolt supplies the potentially destructive discharge.
The angel branch links the atmospheric scene to the later angelic address.
Layered cloud accumulation makes endurance a held and thickening pressure.
Intactness after danger supplies the safe resolution of the charged sequence.

changed_reading.before: Angels greet people after an abstract period of endurance.
changed_reading.after: Endurance can be pictured as charged accumulation under fear and hope, while the angelic declaration marks intact arrival after pressure that could have discharged destructively.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects container and descendant branches of the focus roots to the measured womb sequence; it remains anchored in words 4, 6, and 7 and is reinforced by descendants entering the household. Render as a gestational model of patient holding and continuity, while stating that the causal bridge is reader-supplied.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The endurance root can supply enclosing sides, the consequence root can supply descendants, and the dwelling root can supply household residence.

activation_trace.role: An inward pregnancy or fruit supplies the held developing content.
Decrease supplies one direction of measured gestational change.
The womb supplies the literal chamber in which change is contained.
Growth supplies the other direction of developing change.
A bounded measure supplies regulated development rather than indefinite waiting.
Small dispersed progeny supply the household continuation that emerges from holding.
Sides and enclosing edges make endurance a containing structure.
Descendants who remain afterward make consequence a continuation through lineage.
Residence and household attachment provide the social chamber of that continuation.

changed_reading.before: Endurance is waiting by isolated adults for their own place.
changed_reading.after: Endurance can be modeled as measured gestational holding whose outcome is not merely a place but the safe continuation and gathering of a household across generations.

strongest_changes: Endurance changed from passive delay into selective retention: transient agitation leaves while useful residue remains.
The covenant mirror changed endurance into the force that keeps a relational network joined, with peace as its restored topology.
The failed-reach and every-gate sequence changed the opening from description into a successfully delivered threshold act.
The consequence and dwelling remained multiply live as homecoming loop, regenerative regime, and final clearance after review.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots supported incompatible but traceable mechanisms: safety and reconciliation, retention and delivery, terminal consequence and repeated return, settled house and circulating ecology. Rare material, atmospheric, economic, spatial, and gestational branches produced additional changed readings without displacing the stronger models.
remaining_uncertainties: The homecoming and regenerative readings may be distinct mechanisms or two projections of the same circular branch cluster.
The threshold-clearance and economic-settlement readings may over-literalize transfer and warranty branches even though their focus anchoring is exact.
The cloud, curing, ascent, and gestational models remain poetic material analogies; their directional arrows are less constrained than the covenant and filtering models.
